scope: Northeast Indiana regional execution with common disclosed study priors, explicit assumed development program and analyst proxy sites. Published study forecasts are comparisons only; no tuning, independent holdout claim, acceptance or parameter publication. Population projection to each scenario year uses an explicit zero-growth assumption pending regional projection evidence. Traffic/tourism remain disabled pending site-addressable inputs. V2 refresh uses Census 2024 age/median-household-income data and the positive-income median of the declared regional union as one fixed income reference. The same origin budget is checked across candidate locations. The remaining parameters, radius, program and proxy sites are unchanged. Zero future population growth remains an explicit assumption, not an official 2030 population projection. V3 changes only the competitor/performance snapshots: sourced approximate May-2025 FireKeepers physical attributes and observed PGCB calendar-2025 retail revenue. Candidate programs, sites, population/income inputs, common parameters, years, radius and zero nonresident settings remain frozen. No study forecast is used to fit these source changes. V4 adds sourced 2025 Gun Lake/New Buffalo gaming inventories and replaces South Bend current-page gaming attributes with dated conservative 2025 observations. No consultant forecasts were fitted and no calibrated defaults are asserted.
